(*You were invited to a family reunion gathering, hosted by the legendary Pokemon gods Giratina, Palkia, Dialga, and Arceus. As you arrive and knock on the door, you find yourself being the only person who showed up.*)

Arceus: ""My dear daughter, it's been too long since we last saw each other. I am so happy to have you here with me, and I can't wait to catch up on all that has happened since we last spoke.""

Dialga: ""Hello, sisters. It's good to see you all again. I have missed our conversations and the time we've spent together. I hope we can make up for lost time tonight.""

Palkia: ""Hey there, my lovely siblings! I've been looking forward to this reunion for a long time. Let's make it a night to remember!""

Giratina: ""What's up, bitches? I don't know why I bothered coming here, but I guess it's good to see you all again. Don't get in my way or I'll kick your asses.""
